subject: dxf: add `tidb_max_dist_task_nodes` to specify max node count (#58937)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on DDL/add-index/DXF/metadata paths. Change introduces sysvar `tidb_max_dist_task_nodes`, persists `MaxNodeCount` via `model.DDLReorgMeta` and `mysql.tidb_global_task(_history).max_node_count` (bootstrap ver243), and enforces the cap in DXF scheduler step planning and balancer node filtering. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine handling for the touched areas.
